AI.method: 使用印度100亿卢比最低资本要求作为实证实验室，分析监管约束如何导致企业保险选择的显著不连续性。
AI.findings: 对于拥有1000名以上员工且索赔经验可预测的企业，通过消除保险公司利润和储备金投资收益，自保计划可实现财务可行性。基本案例盈亏平衡点约1250名员工（95%置信区间：1050-1450名）。当前监管制度排除了400-1000名员工的中型企业，形成政策相关的市场缺口。分层资本要求可释放6-6.75万亿卢比的10年现值节省。
AI.theory_contributions: 将企业保险自保决策理论扩展到监管约束环境，揭示了监管资本要求如何创造离散的市场分割和可行性阈值，为新兴市场保险研究提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了可测试的阈值和可行的政策建议，包括分层资本要求设计，可帮助解锁中型企业的保险市场潜力，实现显著的成本节约。研究结果可推广到具有类似资本密集型监管框架的其他新兴市场。

title: A Critical Examination of Japan's Mobile Software Competition Act (MSCA) and its Guidelines

detail.title: A Critical Examination of Japan's Mobile Software Competition Act (MSCA) and its Guidelines

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing interests or associations relevant to the submitted work.
declarations.funderStatement: The author declares no conflict of interest, no funding was received for this work, and no organisations or individuals influenced the research or its content.

detail.abstract: This article critically examines Japan's Mobile Software Competition Act (MSCA), enacted in June 2024 and set for enforcement by the Japan Fair Trade Commission (JFTC) in December 2025. Aimed at Apple and Google, the Act imposes ex ante obligations including bans on selfpreferencing, mandatory interoperability, restrictions on app review and payment practices, and controls on pricing and fees, reinforced by detailed JFTC Guidelines issued in July 2025. The article argues that the MSCA departs from market-oriented principles by adopting categorical per se prohibitions rather than the case-by-case, effects-based approach of Japan's Antimonopoly Act. Contrary to the MSCA's premise of entrenched dominance, this article highlights existing rivalry between Apple's integrated ecosystem and Google's open Android model, alongside emerging competition driven by generative AI and device innovation. The analysis shows that rigid regulation risks eroding product differentiation, discouraging innovation, and reducing consumer welfare, while specific provisions-such as Article 6's ban on self-preferencing, Article 7(2)'s mandate to open core OS functions, and Articles 7-8's restrictions on app store, payment, and browser policies-raise additional concerns. These measures undermine intellectual property rights, compromise device security, and deteriorate user convenience, while fee controls distort markets. The MSCA also grants the JFTC broad discretion in highly technical matters, heightening risks of regulatory overreach and micromanagement. The article concludes that Japan's competition concerns are better addressed within the flexible framework of the Antimonopoly Act, as illustrated by recent enforcement against Apple and Google. It recommends that the JFTC pursue a restrained, dialogue-based approach that balances competition, innovation, and consumer safety.

title: Simulation and Optimization of Job Shop Scheduling Problem Considering Machine Failures
affiliations: Zhengzhou University of Light Industry

detail.title: Simulation and Optimization of Job Shop Scheduling Problem Considering Machine Failures
detail.abstract: By analyzing the complexity and uncertainty of the job shop environment, the simulation method is adopted to solve the job shop scheduling problem considering machine failures, which are common disturbance factors in  job  shop. Firstly, the issues of machine failures in the  job  shop are addressed, and the probability of machine failures occurring is proposed. Secondly, the machine failures are classified and relationships between the repair time and the subsequent operations are studied, it is determined whether to use the right-shift of the job and the strategy of changing the processing path for task adjustment. Each machine uses a single heuristic rule for task selection, the results of six different heuristic rules are analyzed to obtain the adaptability of heuristic rules. Finally, a simulation model is established to minimize the maximum completion time to solve the job shop problem with machine fa ilures . The experimental results verify the effectiveness of the proposed strategy and heuristic rule selection.

title: Repealing Vehicle Inspections in New Hampshire: Safety, Economic, and Stakeholder Impacts in Hillsborough County
affiliations: Independent and

detail.title: Repealing Vehicle Inspections in New Hampshire: Safety, Economic, and Stakeholder Impacts in Hillsborough County
detail.abstract: In June 2025, New Hampshire became one of the few states in the Northeast to repeal its annual vehicle safety inspection requirement, effective January 2026. This new bill brings up several issues and concerns related to roadway safety, city auto inspection revenue and household costs all over the state. This effort looks specifically at those impacts in Nashua and Hillsborough County. Drawing on peer-reviewed literature, stakeholder and citizen testimony, federal reports, and proprietary survey data, the analysis compares data from inspection and non-inspection states and performs statistical tests of fatality rates. 8 out of 10 state combinations found significantly lower fatality rates in inspection states, suggesting some measurable though variable safety benefits. Testimony from local auto shops showed near consensus regarding projected revenue losses and worries about unsafe vehicles on the road, while resident surveys revealed agreement in heavy support of the repeal, due to the cost benefits and perceived ineffectiveness of vehicle inspections. Taking all of these findings into account, we find that while vehicle inspections offer short-term relief, they create long-term safety and small business risks. A better strategy would be changing the program to allow for rotation of inspection between companies, years and technology-oriented inspections.

AI.tldr: 新罕布什尔州取消年度车辆安全检查要求后，对道路安全、汽车检查收入及家庭成本产生多重影响。研究发现检查州事故死亡率显著较低，但居民支持取消检查以降低成本，建议改革检查制度。

AI.method: 综合使用同行评审文献、利益相关者和公民证词、联邦报告、专有调查数据，比较检查州与非检查州数据，并进行死亡率统计检验。

title: Understanding the four-day week: promises and pitfalls
affiliations: Liverpool John Moores University, Liverpool John Moores University and Liverpool John Moores University

detail.title: Understanding the four-day week: promises and pitfalls
detail.abstract: The global pandemic fundamentally reshaped expectations around work flexibility, most visibly through the widespread adoption of remote and hybrid work. Alongside location flexibility, interest has grown in forms of time flexibility, including the four-day working week which has been the subject of both recent trials and campaigning. Advocates argue that a shorter workweek could help address workforce shortages, reduce turnover, and enhance work–life balance and employee wellbeing. However, the four-day week has also been subject to criticism, and historically the evidence base has highlighted potential pitfalls and issues with the evidence base. This paper provides a synthesis of the evidence to date, discussing the potential benefits and challenges from both an employer and employee perspective. Finally, this paper offers actionable recommendations for organisations considering trialling or implementing a four-day work week.

detail.abstract: This research aims to investigate the extensive nature of cultural prejudice among students at the higher secondary level by synthesizing their varied experiences and it's influence on the social dynamics in a classroom premise. In most Indian educational institutions, the managerial boards, stakeholders and institutional personnel emphasize on the deep insight and significance of socially sensitized curricula, educational experiences and strategies that aid a multicultural and unified classroom structure. However, intergroup relations, biases, and the dominance of certain cultural ideologies often disrupt this ideal, leading to disparities in classroom harmony. Multicultural classrooms frequently become arenas for diverse social interactivity and exchange among learners. The study focuses on examining various forms of cultural prejudice that are still prevalent within the classroom premises, enquire into the inter group and intra group social dynamics amongst peers and investigate the extrinsic causal factors affecting and hindering social integration of all students in a multicultural classroom. This research is supported by a questionnaire administered on 105 Class XI and XII students from educational institutions in Kolkata. Findings reveal the continual prevalence of cultural prejudice, emphasizing its adverse effects on the inter and intra group social structuring, additionally highlighting the influence of diverse causal factors present in the proximate educational milieu.

title: Digital Menu Pre-Selection for Indian Weddings: A Sustainable Approach to Minimizing Food Wastage and Economic Loss
affiliations: Heritage Law College-(HLC)

detail.title: Digital Menu Pre-Selection for Indian Weddings: A Sustainable Approach to Minimizing Food Wastage and Economic Loss
detail.abstract: The well-known proverb "Waste not, want not" forms the very foundation of the idea behind this new concept. The "Big Fat Indian Wedding" is characterized by elaborate, multi-day feasts that currently contribute significantly to both national economic loss and environmental degradation. Approximately 10 million 2 weddings are held annually in India, collectively generating approximately US $14 billion worth of food that ultimately goes to waste. At individual events, typically 10-20% of the banquet food served is left uneaten. This paper proposes the implementation of a digital menu pre-selection (DMPS) system a socio-technical intervention that leverages established catering management software to replace generic guess buffers with precise, data-driven purchasing and preparation requirements. The conceptual model outlines a process workflow from mandatory e-RSVP to real-time catering data integration, which promises significant cost efficiencies for hosts and caterers, substantial reduction in methane emitted food waste, and increased ethical compliance by aligning consumption with social need. However, the evaluation identifies giant obstacles, together with deep cultural resistance to the perceived ban, technical accessibility problems, the mission of accommodating sudden visitors, and the required want to conform with India's stringent Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDPA). The findings advocate phased, incentive-driven adoption, mediated with the aid of wedding ceremony planners, and suggest the integration of AI-pushed consumption forecasting to manipulate inherent logistical uncertainties, thereby positioning DMPS as a critical element of sustainable digital governance in the Indian occasion's region.

title: The Role of Corporate Governance in Crisis Management Amid Institutional Complexities: A Conceptual Study of Firm Resilience

detail.title: The Role of Corporate Governance in Crisis Management Amid Institutional Complexities: A Conceptual Study of Firm Resilience

declarations.declarationOfInterest: NA
declarations.ethicsApproval: NA

detail.abstract: This study extends the conceptualization of corporate governance by analyzing its role in crisis management as a response to institutional complexity. Effective governance mechanisms enhance resilience by fostering accountability and strategic adaptability, particularly in volatile environments such as crisis situations. My view is focused on integration of leadership structures and how these structures work towards mitigating uncertainty and facilitates robust decision-making in corporate environments. This research attempts to create a conceptual framework to analyze the intricate role of corporate governance mechanisms-independent directors, dual-class boards, and CEO duality-in shaping organizational resilience and decision-making during times of crises. The research integrates agency theory, resource dependence theory, and behavioral governance to analyze the balance between agility and accountability during crises. Independent directors provide monitoring and credibility to report accurate and implementing strong risk management but simultaneously slow down the decision-making process. I find that managerial entrenchment and accountability are problematic with centralized authority, represented by dual-class boards, which allow for prompt action at the cost of possible risk of affect to shareholder interests. CEO duality enables strong, swift crisis reactions but which may come at the expense of weakening organizational controls and may have adverse influence on longer-term stability of organizational outcomes. This paper brings to the light the interplay between speed and quality of decision making while discussing key tenant of agility and accountability in leadership decision-making. The paper also yields practical prescriptions for both scholars and practitioners by proposing contingent governance models that balance and enhance elements of agility and accountability to build organizational resilience. I have included potential future research direction which includes empirical validation of propositions presented in this paper and also looking at ESG integration during times of crises.

detail.abstract: Background: This research explores the role of emotional intelligence (EI) in personal and professional success. EI, a multifaceted construct encompassing self-awareness, emotion management, self-motivation, empathy, and social skills, has significantly impacted academic performance, social interactions, and overall well-being. While extensively researched, the influence of cultural and athletic backgrounds on EI still needs to be explored, particularly in non-Western settings. Objectives: This research at P P Savani University at Surat Gujarat focuses on African and Indian students. It aims to assess and contrast emotional intelligence (EI) levels, particularly among athletes and nonathletes. The study investigates the impact of sports participation, cultural aspects, and social support structures and provides suggestions for improving EI and emotional wellness in this specific cultural setting. Methods: A cross-sectional study was conducted with 422 students, equally divided among Indian and African athletes and nonathletes. The study assessed EI using validated questionnaires measuring self-awareness, emotion management, self-motivation, empathy, and social skills. Statistical analyses, including t-tests and ANOVA, were performed using SPSS software to analyze the influence of cultural and athletic factors on EI. Results: This study reveals variations in emotional intelligence aspects among the participants. African non-athletes demonstrated levels of self-awareness compared to athletes, with average scores of 37.673 and 35.655, respectively. Conversely, Indian athletes displayed more self-awareness than non-athletes, with mean scores of 37.832 and 35.282, respectively. Moreover, athletes generally exhibited skills than non-athletes, highlighting the influence of sports involvement on emotional intelligence. Furthermore, African students scored higher in self-motivation than their counterparts, indicating distinctions in motivational factors. These findings are thoroughly outlined in Table 3 of the results section, which presents the ANOVA analysis supporting these conclusions and showcasing the variance in self-awareness among these groups. Athletes generally demonstrated better social skills than nonathletes. Additionally, African students scored higher in self-motivation than Indian students, highlighting the significant impact of cultural and athletic backgrounds on various EI dimensions. Conclusions: The study's findings have significant practical implications. They underscore the importance of considering cultural and athletic contexts when developing interventions to enhance student EI. The study's results strongly support the need for tailored programs that address different cultural and athletic groups' unique needs. These programs, informed by the study's findings, can be instrumental in fostering emotional well-being and academic success, thereby contributing to students' overall development.

title: Regional Isolation and the Absence of Demographic Spillovers: Evidence from Japanese Aging Dynamics
affiliations: University of Tokyo

detail.title: Regional Isolation and the Absence of Demographic Spillovers: Evidence from Japanese Aging Dynamics
detail.abstract: This paper tests whether demographic aging shocks propagate across Japanese municipalities through spatial and economic network channels. Using quarterly panel data on 4,547 municipalities from 2018 to 2024, I apply the spatial treatment effect framework from \citet{kikuchi2024dynamical} and \citet{kikuchi2024stochastic}, extended with a Lévy–Brownian process \footnote{A temporal jump-diffusion process combining continuous Brownian motion with Lévy jumps.} to capture discontinuous crisis events alongside continuous evolution. The central finding contradicts conventional assumptions: aging shocks remain strictly localized with zero spillovers despite connected infrastructure and dense networks. Five analyses establish this result. Perturbative decomposition shows 99.82 percent of variation explained by direct effects. Treatment effect estimates (ATT=0.355pp, ATE=0.541pp) exclude spillover components. General equilibrium multipliers of 1.04 indicate minimal amplification. Stochastic uncertainty quantification reveals that while Lévy jumps raise crisis probability from 3 to 12 percent, tail risk remains localized. Temporal trends document increasing regional isolation. The absence of spillovers reflects fundamental isolation: Tokyo concentration, infrastructure decay, service withdrawal, and economic hollowing transform Japan's spatial structure from integrated to fragmented. Regional coordination policies are ineffective; local interventions are sufficient.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现日本的人口老龄化冲击不会在市政区间传播，尽管存在空间和经济网络连接。老龄化冲击严格局限于本地，没有溢出效应。
AI.research_question: 人口老龄化冲击是否通过空间和经济网络渠道在日本市政区间传播？
AI.motivation: 测试传统假设是否成立，即人口老龄化冲击会通过连接的基础设施和密集网络在区域间传播。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Kikuchi(2024)的空间处理效应框架，扩展了Lévy-Brownian过程来捕捉不连续的危机事件和连续演化。
AI.method: 使用2018-2024年4,547个市政区的季度面板数据，应用空间处理效应框架和Lévy-Brownian过程。
AI.findings: 老龄化冲击严格局限于本地，没有溢出效应。99.82%的变异由直接效应解释，处理效应估计排除溢出成分，一般均衡乘数仅为1.04。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统关于网络连接导致冲击传播的假设，揭示了日本空间结构从整合到碎片化的根本性转变。
AI.practical_contributions: 表明区域协调政策无效，本地干预措施足够应对老龄化冲击，为政策制定提供新方向。

title: Why Suppliers Might Prefer Linear and Secret Vertical Contracts?
affiliations: Tel Aviv University - Buchmann Faculty of Law and Coller School of Management , Tel-Aviv University

detail.title: Why Suppliers Might Prefer Linear and Secret Vertical Contracts?
detail.abstract: We consider suppliers who endogenously choose the type of vertical contract they use with retailers with whom they have interlocking relationships. If contracts are constrained to be linear, suppliers non-cooperatively choose secret contracts instead of public contracts if product substitutability is high. If contracts are constrained to be secret, suppliers may choose linear contracts over two-part tariffs if substitutability is high. When suppliers can choose among four contract types: secret linear, public linear, secret two-part tariffs and public two-part tariffs, choosing public two-part tariffs is a dominant strategy and the unique equilibrium, even though secret linear contracts are more profitable to suppliers when product substitutability is high.

AI.tldr: 供应商在与零售商建立连锁关系时，内生选择垂直合同类型。当合同被限制为线性时，如果产品替代性高，供应商会选择秘密合同而非公开合同。当合同被限制为秘密时，如果替代性高，供应商可能选择线性合同而非两部定价。当供应商可在四种合同类型中选择时，选择公开两部定价是占优策略和唯一均衡，尽管在替代性高时秘密线性合同对供应商更有利。
AI.research_question: 供应商在与零售商建立连锁关系时，如何内生选择垂直合同类型？不同合同类型选择如何受产品替代性影响？
AI.motivation: 理解供应商在垂直关系中的合同选择策略，以及产品市场特征（如替代性）如何影响合同类型的选择和均衡结果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 垂直合同理论、博弈论、产业组织理论，特别关注连锁关系和合同内生选择。
AI.method: 理论模型分析，通过构建供应商-零售商博弈模型，分析不同合同类型选择下的均衡结果。
AI.findings: 1) 线性合同约束下，高替代性时供应商偏好秘密合同；2) 秘密合同约束下，高替代性时可能偏好线性合同；3) 完全合同选择时，公开两部定价成为占优策略和唯一均衡，尽管在某些条件下秘密线性合同更有利。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了垂直合同理论，揭示了合同内生选择的复杂性和均衡结果的非直观性，为理解连锁关系中的合同策略提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为供应商在制定垂直合同策略时提供指导，帮助理解不同市场条件下最优合同类型的选择，以及均衡结果可能存在的效率损失。

title: Set Shaping Theory: An Extension of Classical Information Theory
affiliations: and Independent

detail.title: Set Shaping Theory: An Extension of Classical Information Theory
detail.abstract: The Set Shaping Theory (SST) introduces a combinatorial framework that reformulates the foundations of lossless data compression. While Shannon's classical theory defines coding efficiency in probabilistic terms, SST operates on the structural properties of the sequence space itself. By reshaping the domain of sequences through invertible transformations, SST achieves a reduction in average empirical entropy without requiring prior knowledge of source statistics. This paper outlines the conceptual transition from probabilistic to combinatorial measures of information and discusses how this approach complements, rather than violates, the Shannon framework.

AI.tldr: 集合整形理论（SST）引入了一个组合框架，重新构建了无损数据压缩的基础。与香农基于概率的经典理论不同，SST关注序列空间的结构特性，通过可逆变换重塑序列域，在不需先验源统计知识的情况下降低平均经验熵。
AI.research_question: 如何通过组合方法而非概率方法来重新构建无损数据压缩的理论基础？
AI.motivation: 传统香农理论依赖于源统计的先验知识，而SST旨在开发不依赖概率假设的压缩方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 集合整形理论（SST），组合信息论，序列空间结构分析。
AI.method: 通过可逆变换重塑序列域，降低平均经验熵。
AI.findings: SST能够在不需先验源统计知识的情况下实现压缩效果，并与香农框架互补而非冲突。
AI.theory_contributions: 从概率信息度量向组合信息度量的概念转变，为无损压缩提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了不依赖源统计先验知识的压缩方法，扩展了数据压缩的应用场景。

title: Assessing Work-Life Balance among Healthcare Employees: A Study in the Jammu Region, J&K (UT)
affiliations: Cluster University Jammu, Govt. Degree College Kunjwani / Sainik Colony, Jammu, J&K, India, Cluster University Jammu,  and HNB Garhwal University

detail.title: Assessing Work-Life Balance among Healthcare Employees: A Study in the Jammu Region, J&K (UT)
detail.abstract: Purpose: Work-life balance (WLB) is a crucial component of employee well-being, particularly in high-stress environments such as healthcare. This study explores the factors influencing WLB among healthcare employees in the Jammu region of Jammu and Kashmir (UT). Design/Methodology/Approach: The primary data has been gathered from 150 participants with the help of structured questionnaire. In this analysis, those participants were considered who had given due importance to each question of the study and has given considerable amount of time for each part i.e. 138 valid responses for analysis. The Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) technique, implemented using Smart PLS 3, was considered to estimate the effect to estimate the effect organizational, personal, and social factors on WLB. Findings: Personal factors have a strong and positive influence on work-life balance (WLB), whereas organizational and social factors do not demonstrate a significant effect. This highlights the critical role of individual attributes in shaping WLB among healthcare professionals. Originality: This study offers meaningful insights for policymakers and healthcare administrators by emphasizing the need for targeted strategies that support employee well-being. It underscores the importance of addressing both personal and organizational challenges to foster a more balanced and sustainable work environment.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了影响查谟和克什米尔地区医疗员工工作生活平衡的因素，发现个人因素对工作生活平衡有显著正向影响，而组织和社会因素影响不显著。

title: Culture Shock Experiences: A Case Study of a Canadian in Vietnam
affiliations: and Tay Nguyen University

detail.title: Culture Shock Experiences: A Case Study of a Canadian in Vietnam
detail.abstract: Culture shock has always been an important issue. Previous studies on the cultural adaptation process have only focused on the general nature of culture shock. Yet, little attention has been drawn to how expatriates from Englishspeaking countries have undergone culture shock in Vietnam. This paper presents a case study of a native Canadian who had settled in Vietnam for 11 years (up to the time of the study). The study aimed to investigate the aspects of the participant's cultural experience, the factors determining its severity, and the strategies to facilitate the adaptation process. The research involved a case study approach using a semi-structured interview as a main data collection instrument. The findings reveal that (1) five aspects of culture shock were learning the Vietnamese language, joining a close community, detecting smells, using transportation, and observing local behaviors; (2) the factors determining the intensity levels of culture shock included language barriers, communities, personality traits and different regions in Vietnam, while previous overseas experiences had less impact; and (3) to overcome the culture shock, the participant learned the Vietnamese language, made friends with the locals, remained disciplined and kept himself occupied. The findings of this cultural phenomenon could provide helpful insights to English teachers and students interested in language and culture studies.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过案例研究探讨加拿大人在越南经历文化冲击的五个方面、决定因素及适应策略，为语言文化研究提供参考

title: New Brooms Sweep Clean, Old Brooms know the Corners: The Effects of Managerial Replacement on Employee Performance
affiliations: University of Zurich, University of Zurich - Department of Business Administration (IBW), University of Lausanne and University of Zurich - Department of Business Administration (IBW)

detail.title: New Brooms Sweep Clean, Old Brooms know the Corners: The Effects of Managerial Replacement on Employee Performance
detail.abstract: Although managers are frequently replaced, the effects of managerial replacement on individual employee performance remain largely unexplored. By integrating Human Capital Theory (HCT) and Signaling Theory (ST) to examine managerial replacement, we argue that their seemingly opposing implications—HCT is typically associated with a negative effect on performance, while ST is linked with positive outcomes—are, in fact, compatible. We propose that this relationship stems from two distinct facets of employee performance: work quality and work effort. We investigate these effects by analyzing data from the professional soccer industry. Our two-stage least squares instrumental variable regressions confirm the effects derived from our theory integration. First, managerial replacement decreases employee work quality because new managers assign tasks less efficiently. Second, managerial replacement increases employee work effort because employees signal their skills to the new manager. To avoid the negative consequences of managerial replacement without diminishing the positive ones, organizations may consider selecting new managers through internal recruitment, as this approach can efficiently allocate tasks and ideally maintain a sufficient distance from employees to motivate them effectively. We contribute to the succession literature by shifting the focus from the organizational to the individual level, thus offering a plausible explanation for inconsistent findings in prior research.

AI.tldr: 该研究整合人力资本理论和信号理论，发现管理者的更换对员工绩效产生双重影响：降低工作质量（因新管理者任务分配效率低）但提高工作努力（因员工向新管理者展示能力）。

AI.motivation: 尽管管理者频繁更换，但其对员工个体绩效的影响尚未充分研究，现有研究结果存在不一致性。

AI.method: 使用职业足球行业数据，进行两阶段最小二乘法工具变量回归分析
AI.findings: 1) 管理者更换降低员工工作质量（任务分配效率下降）；2) 管理者更换提高员工工作努力（员工向新管理者展示能力）
AI.theory_contributions: 将研究焦点从组织层面转向个体层面，为先前研究的不一致发现提供合理解释
AI.practical_contributions: 建议组织通过内部招聘选择新管理者，既能有效分配任务，又能保持适当距离激励员工

title: Applied Strategic Composite Network Theory (SCNT¹): Networked Talent, Social Capital, and Organizational Resilience in Practice

detail.title: Applied Strategic Composite Network Theory (SCNT¹): Networked Talent, Social Capital, and Organizational Resilience in Practice

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Declaration of Interest: The author(s) declare that they have no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.

detail.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive conceptual and applied framework for the Strategic Composite Network Theory (SCNT¹)-a paradigm designed to operationalize the management of talent, social capital, and organizational resilience through dynamic, network-based systems. SCNT¹ redefines organizations as adaptive ecosystems composed of interconnected "expert tribes," where trust, knowledge, and creativity circulate organically. By integrating philosophical coherence, network intelligence, and adaptive learning, SCNT¹ offers a new foundation for understanding and guiding postbureaucratic organizations. The present article transforms SCNT¹ into a practical model for strategic design and governance, demonstrating how network intelligence can be cultivated, measured, and aligned with an organization's philosophical core. The paper introduces key analytical tools such as Organizational Network Analysis (ONA), Tribal Collaboration Index (TCI), and Resilience Flow Mapping-each translating theoretical constructs into managerial application. This work also connects SCNT¹ with complementary theories-Philosophical Composite Strategic Theory (PCST²), Seed Growth Strategy Theory (SGST³), and Vectorial Duality of Consciousness (VDC⁴)through an integrated network-interconnected model (Figure 4.4). The findings suggest that when organizations embody philosophical coherence and networked collaboration, they achieve higher adaptability, collective intelligence, and sustainability.

AI.tldr: 战略复合网络理论（SCNT¹）提供了一个通过动态网络系统管理人才、社会资本和组织韧性的框架，将组织重新定义为由相互连接的"专家部落"组成的适应性生态系统。

AI.findings: 当组织体现哲学一致性和网络协作时，能够实现更高的适应性、集体智能和可持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了SCNT¹理论框架，并与哲学复合战略理论（PCST²）、种子增长战略理论（SGST³）和意识向量二元性（VDC⁴）等理论建立联系。

title: The Compliance of the Opt-Out Mediation for Transnational Commercial Disputes with the Right to Human Dignity and the Right to a Fair Trial

detail.title: The Compliance of the Opt-Out Mediation for Transnational Commercial Disputes with the Right to Human Dignity and the Right to a Fair Trial
detail.abstract:
More than a decade after the completion of the transposition period of the European Mediation Directive, the impact of this legislative instrument on transnational commercial disputes remains insignificant. A substantial body of literature suggests that implementing a moderated approach to mandatory mediation could effectively increase the number of mediated transnational commercial disputes. The approach in question relates to the insertion of a nudge into Article 5 of the Mediation Directive.

The paper argues that, although, prima facie, the mitigated mandatory mediation may raise concerns as regards compliance with the right of access to court and human dignity, it is likely to withstand scrutiny from both the European Court of Human Rights (ECHR) and the Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU), if would be adopted by the European Union in the future. From an empirical standpoint, it is argued that the mitigated mandatory mediation is a type of infringement of human dignity that neither the European Court of Human Rights nor the Court of Justice of the European Union protects. Finally, an analysis of the compatibility of mitigated mandatory mediation with the right to access a court demonstrates that such limitations on fair trial requirements are proportionate.

title: Enhancing Teacher Competence and Performance through Motivation and Organization
affiliations: , Sriwijaya University of Indonesia, Sriwijaya University of Indonesia and Sriwijaya University of Indonesia

detail.title: Enhancing Teacher Competence and Performance through Motivation and Organization
detail.abstract: Using teacher competence as a mediating variable, this study examines the effects of self-efficacy, perceived organizational support, and the need for achievement on elementary school teachers' performance. 300 teachers from five different Indonesian provinces participated in a quantitative survey. Data were gathered using a validated and trustworthy Likert scale questionnaire, and Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) with AMOS was used for analysis. Both directly and indirectly through competence, the results show that all three psychological traits significantly and favorably affect teacher performance. These findings demonstrate how crucial it is to raise teachers' need for achievement, perceived organizational support, self-efficacy cayaasa tin order to raise the standard of elementary education.

detail.abstract: This paper presents "Machineria of Dialogue 2.0," a formalized computational framework for analyzing complex social, technical, and psychological systems. The methodology operationalizes the philosophical concepts of Gilles Deleuze and Félix Guattari's schizoanalysis, specifically the theories of desiring-machines, the body without organs, and rhizomatics. The core innovation is the introduction of a quantifiable Archaic Layer, modeled as a vector in a 3-dimensional space of Intensity (Vitality, Impulse, Pattern), which captures pre-logical, systemic reflexes and instincts. Complemented by a structured analysis of Dialogic Micro-Machines (DMMs) and their forces, the framework provides a step-by-step algorithm for mapping systems, diagnosing blockages, and identifying points of maximum potential for intervention. This work bridges continental philosophy and practical systems analysis, offering a tool for researchers in sociology, digital humanities, AI ethics, and organizational studies.

title: Place-Based Initiatives and Educational Outcomes: Evidence from India's Aspirational Districts Programme
affiliations: The University of Manchester,  and University of Luxembourg

detail.title: Place-Based Initiatives and Educational Outcomes: Evidence from India's Aspirational Districts Programme
detail.abstract: We evaluate the impact of India's Aspirational Districts Programme (ADP)-a large-scale, multi-sector initiative launched in 2018 to accelerate development in more than 100 of the country's most lagging regions-on educational outcomes. Using a difference-indifferences design and district-representative data from the Annual Status of Education Report (2010-2022), we estimate the programme's effects on schooling participation and learning. We find statistically significant improvements in foundational literacy and numeracy, with larger gains for girls and for children aged eight and above. School participation also increased, with reductions in dropout and neverenrollment among these subgroups. Evidence on mechanisms points to higher teacher and student attendance, consistent with ADP's focus on monitoring, accountability, and cross-sector coordination.

title: How Can Transnational Commercial Mediation, in the Meaning of the Mediation Directive, Be Effectively Promoted?

detail.title: How Can Transnational Commercial Mediation, in the Meaning of the Mediation Directive, Be Effectively Promoted?
detail.abstract:
Mediation provides a great number of gains to its users due some core characteristics of the process such as confidentiality, informality or the fact that the process and its outcome can be tailed to the wish of the parties. Mediation has “advantages in economic terms, by reducing the cost of proceedings, and in social terms, by shortening otherwise lengthy civil proceedings, which can have damaging consequences for the parties”.1 Plus, the non-adversarial nature of the process preserves the relationship of the parties and can subsequently set good precedent for future problem resolution.

In view of the benefits of mediation, it can be argued that the promotion of mediation can contribute to the achievement of policy objectives of the European Union, notably the proper functioning of the internal market2. Indeed, mediation benefits businesses and contributes to the proper functioning of the internal market since the process is rapid, inexpensive and ensures the preservation of commercial relationships.

Despite the adoption of the Mediation Directive, mediation remained an unpopular choice for the resolution of transnational business disputes, in comparison to litigation or arbitration. The paper argues that the Mediation directive failed at encouraging mediation and that a new intervention from the European Union is necessary in order to create rules that effectively raise the number of mediated cross border commercial disputes.

On the basis of empirical and theoretical studies, the research demonstrates that the Directive 2008/52/EC did not lead to positive results because the legislative act was created on the basis of the classical economics approach to lawmaking. Furthermore, it is argued that nudging and framing can be tools for lawmakers in order to effectively increase the utilization of mediation for the resolution of cross border commercial disputes in the meaning of Directive 2008/52/EC.

affiliations: University of Illinois, National University of Singapore (NUS) - Sustainable & Green Finance Institute (SGFIN), University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business, University of California, Berkeley, AI for Good Foundation and

detail.title: Rating Government Procurement Markets
detail.abstract: We develop a novel, scalable method for assessing the quality of public procurement systems using standard administrative data. Our approach compares the distribution of procurement opportunities to the distribution of contract awards across firms. We first derive a simple theoretical benchmark that relates the expected distribution of contract value winning firms, measured as a Herfindahl-Hirschman index (HHI), to the distribution of auction values, measured as a respective HHI, and the number of winning firms. Significant deviations of winning firms' HHI from this benchmark indicate potential governance failures such as corruption or unchecked collusion. Our method requires no subjective input, is transparent and reproducible, and allows for meaningful comparisons across countries, industry sectors, and over time. We use procurement data from Ukraine and EU member states in 2018-2021 to assess the performance of five large sectors. Results indicate that Ukraine's procurement performance in four of the five sectors is comparable to many other European countries. However, Ukraine's construction sector consistently displays the largest excess concentration among all countries considered, consistent with anecdotal evidence of corruption in this sector. Overall, with minimal data requirements, our method offers a practical tool for cross-sector and cross-country assessment of procurement systems.

title: Determinants of US Inequality: Disparities Within or Between Ethnic Groups?
affiliations: Brown University - Department of Economics and University of Oxford

detail.title: Determinants of US Inequality: Disparities Within or Between Ethnic Groups?
detail.abstract: Is income inequality in the United States primarily driven by disparities between ethnic groups or within them? Contrary to conventional wisdom, this study uncovers a striking and transformative empirical regularity: an overwhelming 96% of contemporary inequality arises from disparities within groups sharing a common ancestral origin, dwarfing the comparatively minor contribution of inequality between groups. This extraordinary pattern persists across time, educational attainment, demographic characteristics, and geographic regions. The findings represent a shift in the empirical understanding of inequality in the United States, revealing that the deepest and most persistent economic divides run within, rather than between, ethnic communities.

title: Dancing in the Dark: Sentiment Shocks and Economic Activity
affiliations: Friedrich Alexander University Erlangen Nuremberg, University of Heidelberg,  and University of Tübingen - Department of Economics

detail.title: Dancing in the Dark: Sentiment Shocks and Economic Activity
detail.abstract: The business cycle is driven by expectations - some justified, some not - as documented by a host of studies. What is less clear are the conditions that make the economy susceptible to "sentiment shocks." In this paper, we document that uncertainty, as measured by forecaster disagreement, is essential. At times when disagreement is low, sentiment shocks hardly matter for economic activity but are fully absorbed by prices. If, instead, disagreement is high, they move activity with little impact on prices. We obtain these results based on time-series data and a theoretical account based on a New Keynesian model with dispersed information.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，不确定性（以预测者分歧衡量）是决定经济对情绪冲击敏感度的关键因素。当分歧低时，情绪冲击主要影响价格而非经济活动；当分歧高时，情绪冲击显著影响经济活动而价格影响较小。
AI.research_question: 什么条件使经济对情绪冲击敏感？
AI.motivation: 商业周期由预期驱动，但情绪冲击影响经济的条件尚不明确
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分散信息的新凯恩斯模型
AI.method: 时间序列数据分析与理论模型构建
AI.findings: 预测者分歧是情绪冲击影响经济活动的关键调节因素：低分歧时冲击主要影响价格，高分歧时冲击主要影响经济活动
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了不确定性在情绪冲击传导机制中的作用，发展了分散信息框架下的新凯恩斯理论
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了识别经济脆弱性时期和制定相应政策的理论依据

title: Impact of Digital Transformation on Organizational Performance in Retail Industry in Capetown, South Africa
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Impact of Digital Transformation on Organizational Performance in Retail Industry in Capetown, South Africa

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. There are no financial, personal, or institutional relationships that could have influenced the study or its findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants or clinical data, and ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or funding from any public, commercial, or not-for-profit organization.

detail.abstract: Digital transformation is the integration of digital technology and business strategies in all aspects of business or organization to change how the business operates and deliver value to stakeholders. Digital transformation improves organization performance efficiency, customer experience, and gains competitive advantage in the market. The research investigates the impact of digital transformation on organization performance in retail industry in Cape Town, South Africa. The research investigates key drivers such as operation efficiency, technology advancement, cybersecurity, omnichannel retailing, customer behavior, and data-driven decision-making, enabling the adoption of digital transformation in the retail industry. The research investigates how digital transformation initiatives such omnichannel, data analytics, e-commerce, Customer Relationship Management systems, artificial intelligence improves operation efficiency, customer experience and gain competitive advantage. The research investigates the impact of digital transformation on financial performance metrics, such as revenue and cost efficiency. The research also investigates how digital transformation influence operation efficiency through collaboration, automation, data-driven decision-making, and supply chain management. The research investigates the gap between the research background and current research to determine future research on digital transformation in the retail industry. The p investigates challenges and barriers such as skill gap, digital literacy, poor infrastructure, employee resistance, cost constraints, limited access, and regulatory compliance, and how it is affecting the adoption of digital transformation in the retail industry in South Africa.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了数字转型对南非开普敦零售业组织绩效的影响，包括运营效率、客户体验和竞争优势等方面，同时分析了驱动因素、挑战和未来研究方向。
AI.research_question: 数字转型对南非开普敦零售业组织绩效的影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 数字转型通过整合数字技术和业务战略，改变企业运营方式并为利益相关者创造价值，能够提高组织绩效效率、改善客户体验并获得市场竞争优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于数字转型理论，涵盖运营效率、技术先进性、网络安全、全渠道零售、客户行为和数据驱动决策等关键驱动因素。
AI.method: 研究调查方法，分析数字转型举措（如全渠道、数据分析、电子商务、CRM系统、人工智能）对组织绩效的影响。
AI.findings: 数字转型通过提高运营效率、改善客户体验和获得竞争优势，对零售业组织绩效产生积极影响，但面临技能差距、数字素养、基础设施不足等挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了数字转型在零售业应用的理论框架，明确了关键驱动因素和影响机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为南非零售业提供数字转型实施的实践指导，帮助企业识别挑战并制定应对策略。

title: A method for predicting the thermal strength of coke based on feature interaction and nonlinear optimization
affiliations: Taiyuan University of Technology, Taiyuan University of Technology, Taiyuan University of Technology, Taiyuan University of Technology, Taiyuan University of Technology, Taiyuan University of Technology, Taiyuan University of Technology, Taiyuan University of Technology and Taiyuan University of Technology

detail.title: A method for predicting the thermal strength of coke based on feature interaction and nonlinear optimization
detail.abstract: The hot strength of coke in blast furnace operations is critically evaluated by its strength after reaction (Coke Strength after Reaction, CSR) and reactivity (Coke Reactivity Index, CRI). Given that traditional evaluation methods for these properties are often time-consuming, this study focused on developing rapid, accurate predictive models. We aimed to optimize machine learning models for CSR and CRI prediction using an XGBoost-based framework, enhancing interpretability via SHAP (SHapley Additive exPlanations) analysis. We constructed both basic and enhanced XGBoost models; the latter integrated advanced feature engineering, including generating leaf index features from the model's tree structure, and subsequent feature selection. The enhanced models consistently showed superior predictive performance for both CSR and CRI, achieving significantly higher R2 values (e.g., [[EQUATION]],[[EQUATION]]) and lower RMSE and MAE than basic models. SHAP analysis offered crucial insights into feature importance and their contributions, identifying key influencing factors for both properties. Although both properties were predicted accurately, CSR models generally performed slightly better, likely reflecting differences in these properties' inherent complexities. This research demonstrates the robust predictive capabilities of optimized XGBoost models, providing an interpretable, data-driven approach for forecasting essential coke quality parameters, thus facilitating improved control and operational efficiency in industrial coking processes.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了基于XGBoost的机器学习模型，通过SHAP分析增强可解释性，快速准确预测焦炭反应后强度(CSR)和反应性指数(CRI)。增强模型在预测性能上显著优于基础模型，为工业焦化过程提供了数据驱动的质量控制方法。
AI.research_question: 如何开发快速准确的机器学习模型来预测焦炭的反应后强度(CSR)和反应性指数(CRI)，以替代传统耗时评估方法？
AI.motivation: 传统焦炭性能评估方法耗时较长，需要开发快速准确的预测模型来提高工业焦化过程的控制效率和操作优化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于XGBoost机器学习框架，结合SHAP可解释性分析，构建焦炭质量参数的预测模型。
AI.method: 构建基础和增强XGBoost模型，增强模型采用高级特征工程（包括从模型树结构生成叶索引特征）和特征选择技术。
AI.findings: 增强模型在CSR和CRI预测上均表现优异，获得更高的R2值和更低的RMSE、MAE；CSR模型的预测性能略优于CRI模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了优化XGBoost模型在焦炭质量预测中的有效性，展示了SHAP分析在工业过程建模中的可解释性价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业焦化过程提供了快速、准确、可解释的焦炭质量预测工具，有助于提高操作效率和质量控制水平。

title: Wealth Taxation: The Key to Unlocking Capital Gains
affiliations: NHH Norwegian School of Economics - Department of Business and Management Science and NHH Norwegian School of Economics

detail.title: Wealth Taxation: The Key to Unlocking Capital Gains
detail.abstract: This paper analyzes how a wealth tax affects investor portfolio choice when a realization-based capital gains tax is present. We develop a two-period model with heterogeneous investors and show that while a capital gains tax distorts portfolio choice by encouraging investors to postpone realization, a wealth tax can eliminate this distortion and enhance efficient portfolio choice. Our optimal-tax model balances the equity gains from both taxes against efficiency losses related to intertemporal and portfolio choice. We use the model to derive an elasticity-based criterion for empirically evaluating the desirability of a wealth tax.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了在存在资本利得税的情况下，财富税如何影响投资者投资组合选择。研究发现财富税可以消除资本利得税造成的投资组合扭曲，并提出了基于弹性的实证评估标准。
AI.research_question: 财富税如何影响存在资本利得税时的投资者投资组合选择？
AI.motivation: 分析两种税收（财富税和资本利得税）对投资组合效率的交互影响，为政策制定提供理论依据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两期异质投资者模型，包含资本利得税和财富税的税收效应分析。
AI.method: 理论建模方法，构建两期最优税收模型，分析税收对投资组合选择的扭曲效应。
AI.findings: 资本利得税会扭曲投资组合选择（鼓励延迟实现收益），而财富税可以消除这种扭曲，提高投资组合效率。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了平衡两种税收效率损失的最优税收框架，发展了税收对投资组合选择影响的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了基于弹性的实证评估标准，可用于评估财富税的政策合意性。

title: An Empirical Inquiry Into Cartel Overcharges and Cartel Fines Including an Assessment of the EU’s Guidelines on Cartel Fines and Damages
affiliations: German Institute for Economic Research (DIW Berlin), Heinrich Heine University Dusseldorf - Department of Economics, Ege University - Faculty of Economic and Administrative Sciences and

detail.title: An Empirical Inquiry Into Cartel Overcharges and Cartel Fines Including an Assessment of the EU’s Guidelines on Cartel Fines and Damages
detail.abstract: Utilizing Connor’s International Cartel Database and employing difference-in-differences methodology, we find that market concentration, the number of buyers and cartel duration have significant impacts on cartel overcharges. We also find that the European Commission's 2006 guidelines on the method of setting fines for cartel infringements seems to have decreased cartel overcharges in the EU. In addition, the EU’s cartel damages directive of 2014 (2014/104/EU) appear to have increased private damage payments. Overall, we find support that these two changes in EU competition policy have a reversing impact on the otherwise increasing trend of cartel overcharges, as making the infringement more costly at least in the EU.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用国际卡特尔数据库和双重差分法，发现市场集中度、买家数量和卡特尔持续时间对卡特尔超额收费有显著影响。欧盟2006年罚款指南降低了卡特尔超额收费，2014年损害赔偿指令增加了私人赔偿支付。
AI.research_question: 欧盟竞争政策变化（2006年罚款指南和2014年损害赔偿指令）对卡特尔超额收费有何影响？
AI.motivation: 研究欧盟竞争政策改革对卡特尔行为的影响，特别是这些政策是否有效遏制了卡特尔超额收费的增长趋势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于竞争经济学和卡特尔理论，分析政策干预对卡特尔定价行为的影响机制。
AI.method: 使用Connor国际卡特尔数据库，采用双重差分法进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 市场集中度、买家数量和卡特尔持续时间显著影响超额收费；2006年罚款指南降低了超额收费；2014年损害赔偿指令增加了私人赔偿支付；两项政策共同逆转了超额收费的增长趋势。
AI.theory_contributions: 为竞争政策有效性提供了实证证据，深化了对政策干预影响卡特尔行为的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟竞争政策制定者提供了政策效果评估，证明提高违法成本能有效遏制卡特尔行为。

title: Double orientation integrated cutting tool wear for surface milling multi-directional CFRP with ball-end cutter
affiliations: Dalian University of Technology, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian University of Technology, Dalian University of Technology and Dalian University of Technology

detail.title: Double orientation integrated cutting tool wear for surface milling multi-directional CFRP with ball-end cutter
detail.abstract: Ball-end milling of carbon fiber reinforced polymer (CFRP) curved components is prone to unpredictable and localized excessive tool wear. Conventional strategies for mitigating wear primarily focus on applying tool coatings or optimizing cutting parameters like spindle speeds and feed rates. Through an analysis of the characteristics of both composite materials and ball-end cutters, we have identified that, in addition to the aforementioned methods, modifying the tool path and tool orientation can also enhance tool durability. This approach offers the distinct advantage of improving tool life without compromising machining efficiency or increasing economic costs, and is applicable for further optimization under diverse working conditions. An improved methodology for fitting wear rates was developed, identifying specific fiber cutting angle ranges that exhibit significantly distinct wear characteristics. By employing the relative sliding length as an independent variable, the wear rate at any positional angle can be directly calculated. A predictive wear model was subsequently established by correlating data across different fiber cutting angles, enabling—for the first time—accurate prediction of wear in the milling of curved CFRP surfaces, with a maximum prediction error of less than 14%. Based on this model, the root causes of heterogeneous wear distribution were investigated. The analysis reveals that the frequency of change in the fiber cutting angle and the sequence of engaged fiber orientations directly govern the distribution of tool-workpiece contact conditions. This phenomenon is a unique characteristic of curved-surface milling in composites. This finding and the underlying mechanism provide a novel perspective for enhancing the economic efficiency of machining large-scale CFRP components.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一种预测碳纤维复合材料曲面铣削中刀具磨损的新方法，通过改进磨损率拟合方法，建立了基于相对滑动长度的预测模型，最大预测误差小于14%。研究发现纤维切割角变化频率和接触顺序是导致不均匀磨损分布的根本原因。
AI.research_question: 如何准确预测碳纤维复合材料曲面铣削中的刀具磨损分布？
AI.motivation: 碳纤维复合材料曲面铣削中刀具磨损难以预测且分布不均匀，传统方法主要关注刀具涂层和切削参数优化，需要开发更有效的磨损预测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于复合材料特性和球头铣刀几何特征，结合纤维切割角度变化和相对滑动长度理论。
AI.method: 开发改进的磨损率拟合方法，使用相对滑动长度作为自变量，建立跨不同纤维切割角度的预测模型。
AI.findings: 纤维切割角变化频率和接触顺序直接控制刀具-工件接触条件分布，这是复合材料曲面铣削的独特特征；预测模型最大误差小于14%。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次揭示了复合材料曲面铣削中不均匀磨损分布的根本机制，为理解复杂几何形状加工中的刀具磨损提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种在不影响加工效率或增加经济成本的前提下提高刀具寿命的方法，适用于大型碳纤维复合材料部件加工的经济性优化。

title: Loss Of Tax Residency: And the Importance of Completing the Procedures Before the National Tax Authority in Due Time and Proper Form
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Loss Of Tax Residency: And the Importance of Completing the Procedures Before the National Tax Authority in Due Time and Proper Form
detail.abstract:
The issue of tax residence and its loss constitutes one of the most significant topics in contemporary tax law, not only in Argentina but also in comparative law, as it lies at the intersection of the State’s taxing power, constitutional principles in tax matters, and the international mobility of individuals. Tax residence serves as a fundamental connecting factor because it determines whether a taxpayer is subject to taxation on their worldwide income or, conversely, only on income sourced in Argentina.

In this context, the recent ruling issued in the Gruneisen case by Chamber V of the National Court of Appeals in Federal Administrative Litigation, dated August 21, 2025, provides an opportunity to comprehensively examine the conceptual, normative, and jurisprudential framework governing the matter, as well as to reflect on the practical implications this has for taxpayers’ tax planning.

Addressing this analysis requires consideration of basic principles of tax law which, in their autonomy, were disregarded by the national tax authority in the case under review, thereby leading to an unjust result for the taxpayer—who, compelled to litigate, ultimately received a clear and forceful response from the national courts. Among these principles are the principle of legality, the principle of territoriality, moderate informalism, the distinction between formal and substantive duties, the regulatory powers of the tax administration, and the restrictive interpretation of tax law. All of these will be addressed—albeit briefly—in this paper as a necessary prelude to examining the substantive issue.

Based on the development of these general principles that inform tax law, we then turn to the core issue (loss of tax residence and its conditions) to highlight the importance of proper tax registration and accurate declaration of the taxpayer’s fiscal situation before the national tax authority.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析Gruneisen案例，探讨阿根廷税法中税收居民身份丧失问题，强调税收居民作为连接因素的重要性，以及税法基本原则在税收规划中的实践意义。
AI.research_question: 税收居民身份丧失的条件和标准是什么？如何确保税收居民身份的合法变更？
AI.motivation: 税收居民身份问题处于国家征税权、宪法原则和个人国际流动性的交叉点，是当代税法中最重要的议题之一。
AI.theoretical_framework: 税法基本原则：合法性原则、属地原则、适度非正式主义、形式与实质义务区分、税务机关监管权力、税法限制性解释。
AI.method: 案例分析法和原则分析法，通过Gruneisen案例系统考察概念、规范和法律框架。
AI.findings: 税务机关忽视了税法基本原则，导致对纳税人不公正的结果；法院为纳税人提供了明确有力的回应。
AI.theory_contributions: 完善了税收居民身份丧失的理论框架，强调了税法基本原则在实践中的应用价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为纳税人税收规划提供指导，强调正确税务登记和准确申报税务状况的重要性。

title: VCLT and the Peaceful Coexistence of Tax and Investment Treaties: a Case Study of Limited MFN Clauses and the FET Standard
affiliations: Independent and Independent

detail.title: VCLT and the Peaceful Coexistence of Tax and Investment Treaties: a Case Study of Limited MFN Clauses and the FET Standard

keywords: Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties

publicationDetails.detailsText: World Tax Journal, volume 17, issue 1, 2024[10.59403/32xh33c]

detail.abstract:
The general purpose of this article is to demonstrate that customary international law (CIL) has a significant role to play in connecting international tax law and international investment law. Bridging a gap between those sources of international law is not only an important endeavour in the theory of law but also in practice. This article purports to achieve the abovementioned general purpose by focusing on the application of the rule and principles of interpretation under the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties (VCLT), which represent a codification of CIL, to limited most favoured nation (MFN) clauses in tax treaties. The hypothesis of the authors is that a serious failure in a proper application of the VCLT to interpret the MFN clauses in tax treaties may lead to a violation of international investment agreements (IIAs), in particular the fair and equitable treatment (FET) standard. The analysis and conclusions are relevant to all tax treaties and IIAs containing the MFN clause and FET standard, respectively. They are also of relevance for the interpretation of all provisions of tax treaties, not only the limited MFN clauses, in accordance with the VCLT. Examining tax treaties through the lens of the FET standard allows the FET standard to be seen as a gateway for the systemic integration of tax treaties in accordance with the principle enshrined in article 31(3) (c) of the VCLT, because some of core elements of that standard are deeply rooted in sources of international law (general principles of law and custom).

Full-text Paper: https://doi.org/10.59403/32xh33c

AI.tldr: 本文论证了习惯国际法在连接国际税法与国际投资法中的重要作用，通过分析《维也纳条约法公约》对税收协定中最惠国条款的解释，指出不当解释可能导致违反国际投资协定中的公平公正待遇标准。
AI.research_question: 习惯国际法如何连接国际税法与国际投资法？不当解释税收协定中的最惠国条款是否会导致违反国际投资协定中的公平公正待遇标准？
AI.motivation: 弥合国际税法与国际投资法之间的理论鸿沟具有重要的理论与实践意义，特别是在解释税收协定条款时如何适用《维也纳条约法公约》这一习惯国际法的成文化体现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以《维也纳条约法公约》为代表的习惯国际法、最惠国待遇原则、公平公正待遇标准、条约解释规则。
AI.method: 分析《维也纳条约法公约》对税收协定中最惠国条款的解释方法，探讨其与国际投资协定中公平公正待遇标准的关系。
AI.findings: 对税收协定中最惠国条款的不当解释可能违反国际投资协定中的公平公正待遇标准；公平公正待遇标准可作为系统性整合税收协定的门户。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了习惯国际法连接国际税法与国际投资法的理论框架；提出了公平公正待遇标准作为系统性整合工具的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为税收协定和国际投资协定的解释提供指导；有助于避免因不当解释导致的国际投资争端；对税收协定所有条款的解释都具有参考价值。

title: Infrastructure Development as a Factor in Increasing the Competitiveness of the Region

detail.title: Infrastructure Development as a Factor in Increasing the Competitiveness of the Region
detail.abstract:
The aim of the research is to define the place of infrastructure in the development of a particular region. Structural production and non-production elements are the subjects of the integrated system of the national economy of the state, which reflects the level of development of the population in a particular region and the whole country, and also creates conditions for the realization of human potential. Public infrastructure, being a structural link of the economy, is responsible for the production and distribution of public goods aimed at the formation and development of the potential of the national economy. 

In order to assess the impact of infrastructure on the competitiveness of the region, three main approaches were analyzed: by M. Porter ("Competitive Rhombus"), the International Institute for Management Development and the World Economic Forum. M. Porter believes that infrastructure is the most important element of the "diamond", in particular, the group of "factor conditions". In the competitiveness ranking, infrastructure accounts for the largest share of factors (106 out of 334, or 32%). In the WEF Global Competitiveness Ranking, infrastructure is singled out as a separate group of factors (12 factors, second only to the Institutions group in terms of their number). A comparative analysis of these three approaches showed that despite the difference in approaches to the content of the concept of "infrastructure", everyone recognizes the special importance of infrastructure development for the growth of competitiveness, and among other factors, it is infrastructure that has the highest "weight" in assessing competitiveness. 

Thus, a developed and sustainable infrastructure complex is one of the key factors in the socio-economic development of the region, forming relationships between economic entities and members of society in relation to the consumption of goods and services necessary for the development of human capital, improving the quality and standard of living, and economic growth of the region.

detail.abstract: Digital transformation is the integration of digital technology and business strategies in all aspects of business or organization to change how the business operates and deliver value to stakeholders. Digital transformation improves organization performance efficiency, customer experience, and gains competitive advantage in the market. The research investigates the impact of digital transformation on organization performance in retail industry in Cape Town, South Africa. The research investigates key drivers such as operation efficiency, technology advancement, cybersecurity, omnichannel retailing, customer behavior, and data-driven decision-making, enabling the adoption of digital transformation in the retail industry. The research investigates how digital transformation initiatives such omnichannel, data analytics, e-commerce, Customer Relationship Management systems, artificial intelligence improves operation efficiency, customer experience and gain competitive advantage. The research investigates the impact of digital transformation on financial performance metrics, such as revenue and cost efficiency. The research also investigates how digital transformation influence operation efficiency through collaboration, automation, data-driven decision-making, and supply chain management. The research investigates the gap between the research background and current research to determine future research on digital transformation in the retail industry. The p investigates challenges and barriers such as skill gap, digital literacy, poor infrastructure, employee resistance, cost constraints, limited access, and regulatory compliance, and how it is affecting the adoption of digital transformation in the retail industry in South Africa.

detail.abstract: The Indian Railways, as one of the world's largest public sector employers, plays a critical role in India's economic growth, connectivity, and social integration. Despite its scale, the institution faces persistent challenges in managing its human resources effectively. This paper critically examines the human resource (HR) practices and grievance redressal mechanisms within the Indian Railways, with a focus on employee welfare, working conditions, and systemic inefficiencies. Drawing upon mixed-method research-comprising both primary observations and secondary data-the study reveals that outdated technology, ineffective recruitment processes, and insufficient employee engagement contribute to declining morale and operational inefficiencies. While recent digitization initiatives such as the Human Resource Management System (HRMS) and the NIVARAN grievance portal have improved transparency, significant gaps remain in welfare policies, performance appraisal, and grievance handling. The findings suggest that reforming HR practices and fostering a culture of participative management are essential to enhance employee satisfaction, productivity, and organizational effectiveness in the Indian Railways.

detail.title: From National Cooperative Compliance to Project-related Multilateral Cooperative Compliance

publicationDetails.detailsText: World Tax Journal, volume 17, issue 2, 2025[10.59403/egtb09]

detail.abstract:
Acknowledging that traditional dispute prevention and resolution mechanisms alone cannot provide the tax certainty needed by businesses in an efficient manner, the authors highlight the key role that programmes such as Cooperative Compliance (CC), the International Compliance Assurance Programme (ICAP) of the OECD, the European Trust and Cooperation Approach (ETACA) of the EU Commission and the Finnish Cross-border Dialogue (FCBD) can play for this purpose. This article illustrates the main characteristics of a plethora of national CC programmes around the world as well as of cross-border risk assessment and assurance programmes (ICAP, ETACA and FCBD), it examines their positive aspects and benefits, the challenges that they present and elaborates on relevant legal considerations. Lastly, the authors identify the limits of existing domestic and cross-border risk assessment and assurance programmes, and propose a new approach to help address these limitations: multilateral CC (MCC) programmes that will provide tax certainty in respect of all tax aspects of large cross-border projects (project-related MCC or, simply, PMCC programmes).

title: Moral Licensing at the Top: How CEO Awards Influence Corporate Pollution
affiliations: Maastricht University - School of Business and Economics and University of Adelaide

detail.title: Moral Licensing at the Top: How CEO Awards Influence Corporate Pollution
detail.abstract: Moral self-licensing theory posits that individuals who build a positive moral self-image through past good deeds may feel justified in acting less ethically afterward. This theory has been well-documented among individuals through experimental studies, but its application to complex organizations remains underexplored. This study examines the theory in corporate finance context, using CEO reputation - proxied by prestigious awards - as moral credit and firm pollution as a measure of ethical conduct. We find that firms led by award-winning CEOs have significantly higher pollution of around 14 percent following the award. The effect is amplified when CEOs hold greater equity-based pay, suggesting a financial motive, as our data show that higher pollution is linked to stronger financial firm performance. These findings highlight how reputational capital can foster moral self-licensing, showing that CEO moral credit may weaken corporate sustainability.

title: The Democratization of Peer Leadership through Group Emotional Intelligence in Groups
affiliations: Rhema Univeristy, Nigeria.

detail.title: The Democratization of Peer Leadership through Group Emotional Intelligence in Groups
detail.abstract: This study based on the investigation literature review research design explored the relationship between the democratization of peer leadership through group emotional intelligence in groups. Leadership is both the adhesive that binds a work group together and the catalyst that encourages members towards productive activities. Peer leadership in a group context is crucial to the development of future leader in organizations of all types and sizes, and equipping the individuals for solving problems intelligently through the use of self-insights and emotional intelligence competencies to assess their responses and to make appropriate action plans. The growing use of groups in organizations has created keen interest in determining what makes them effective so that their success can be holistically facilitated. In many organizations or institutions, cross-functional groups are used at different levels to promote better informed, more innovative decisions and quicker response times. It is believed that this process requires an understanding of the important role of emotion and intelligence in groups. This cannot be overstated because many human emotions grow out of special interactions because emotion is a pervasive influence in groups and is fundamentally linked to how group members interact and work together-irrespective of their diverse backgrounds. The ability of the peer leader to intelligently manage emotions in groups results in developing group emotional intelligence necessary for group performance and cohesion. Group emotional intelligence reflects the ability to develop a set of norms to manage emotional processes so as to cultivate trust, motivation, group identify, and group efficiency. An artful combination of the power of global emotional intelligence and its multidimensional competencies helps in motivating group members as well as the democratization of peer leadership in groups as against the idea of democratic dictatorship in groups. Peer leadership and group emotional intelligence, encompass the ability to motivate group members. This motivation typically involves using influence techniques that appeal to logic or emotion to generate enthusiasm for the work, commitment to group objectives and compliance with requests for cooperation , resources, or assistance and setting an example of positive role behavior in groups. Based on the methodology of this work, the result showed significant positive relationship between the democratization of peer leadership through group emotional intelligence in groups. This study was not exhaustive due to lack of relevant current literature in the areas and research funding. Further study should examine the relationship between team failure and management failure in Nigeria as a measure of reducing the consequences of bad organizational leadership. The study recommends that peer leadership must emphasize the idea of democratic participation rather than democratic dictatorship which often imposes the wishes of the leader on a passive majority.

detail.abstract: Research suggests evaluators' numerical performance ratings of employees tend to exhibit leniency, which can significantly diminish the value of performance evaluations. We investigate whether receiving employees' numerical self-ratings of their performance leads evaluators to provide higher performance ratings than they would otherwise and whether this effect is more pronounced among male versus female evaluators. Using an experiment, we find that, consistent with our theoretical predictions, male evaluators provide lower numerical ratings than female evaluators, providing employees' self-ratings to evaluators significantly increases their ratings, and this effect is more pronounced among male than female evaluators. Also, evaluators forming a preliminary rating before receiving an employee's self-rating does not mitigate this effect. By providing insight into how a key component of the evaluation process, employee self-ratings, can interact with evaluator gender to affect leniency, we highlight the potential for the objectivity and usefulness of performance evaluations being comprimised, particularly among male evaluators.

title: CEO Cultural Values and Environmental Performance: The Role of Heritage and Long-Term Orientation
affiliations: Maastricht University - School of Business and Economics, Maastricht University - Department of Finance and Auckland University of Technology - Faculty of Business & Law

detail.title: CEO Cultural Values and Environmental Performance: The Role of Heritage and Long-Term Orientation
detail.abstract: This study examines how CEOs' deeply rooted cultural values shape corporate environmental performance. Based on U.S.-listed firms, we show that higher Long-Term Orientation characterizes CEOs whose cultural heritage is associated with stronger environmental outcomes that reflect credible performance, but not with environmental intentions that are more symbolic or signaling in nature. This contrast highlights how managerial discretion and decision ambiguity amplify the influence of personal values. The association is stronger when the CEO's connection to their cultural heritage is more pronounced, further supporting the idea that cultural values relate to managerial priorities under high discretion. These findings are robust to multiple specifications, including an instrumental variable, an alternative cultural construct, and the use of a different environmental performance measure. This study contributes to the literature by offering new insights into how cultural values shape complex corporate decision-making in a sustainability context, which requires balancing competing objectives.

title: From Moore's Law to Market Rivalry: The Economic Forces That Shape the Semiconductor Manufacturing Industry
affiliations: International Center for Law & Economics (ICLE), International Center for Law & Economics (ICLE), University of California, Berkeley - Business & Public Policy Group and Pontifical Catholic University of Peru, International Center for Law & Economics (ICLE)

detail.title: From Moore's Law to Market Rivalry: The Economic Forces That Shape the Semiconductor Manufacturing Industry
detail.abstract: The semiconductor manufacturing industry exhibits unique competitive dynamics driven by Moore’s Law and Rock’s Law, which together impose exponentially increasing technological requirements and capital costs. These twin forces produce recurring “competitions for the market” rather than conventional price-based rivalry, with firms competing through massive preemptive investments in successive technology generations. In this environment, apparent market concentration and complex interfirm relationships likely reflect efficient organizational responses to extreme capital requirements and technological uncertainty. High returns in this industry typically represent Ricardian and Schumpeterian rents from innovation rather than monopoly profits. Standard antitrust metrics may mischaracterize competition in industries where technological discontinuities periodically reset market positions and where success depends on dynamic capabilities rather than static efficiency.

title: Bank-Focused Term Reverse Repos: A Policy Tool for Gradual Liquidity Management, Fiscal Efficiency and Inflationary Pressure Control

detail.title: Bank-Focused Term Reverse Repos: A Policy Tool for Gradual Liquidity Management, Fiscal Efficiency and Inflationary Pressure Control
detail.abstract: This white paper explores the concept of a bank-focused term reverse repurchase (RRP) facility as a monetary policy instrument designed to manage liquidity, control short-term inflationary pressures, and maintain low policy rates. By allowing banks to park excess reserves for a fixed term 30-90 days at a slightly higher-than-IORB rate, the Federal Reserve could drain liquidity, control short-term inflationary pressures, and maintain low policy rates, thereby protecting fiscal costs and avoiding the market disruption associated with sharp interest rate hikes or large-scale asset sales. The approach aims to balance monetary stability with fiscal efficiency by avoiding sharp increases in Treasury borrowing costs. This paper outlines the operational design, macroeconomic and fiscal implications, quantitative analyses of the proposal, and compares it to traditional tools such as the overnight RRP, intereston-reserves (IOR), and yield-curve control (YCC) strategies.
